# District 9 Elections

- **[Deputies Elections](https://flow.je/elections/district-9#deputies)**

**[Grouville Elections](https://flow.je/elections/grouville)**

## Deputies Elections

The 2022 elections are the first to utilise the new electoral districts.

* * *

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (2 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**[Carolyn Labey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey), [Steve Luce](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-luce) and [Rose Binet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rose-binet) were elected as Deputies of District 9 in 2022.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Carolyn Labey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey)** |  | 1,981 | 63.7% |
| 2 | **[Steve Luce](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/steve-luce)** | The Progress Party | 1,616 | 51.9% |
| 3 | **[Rose Binet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rose-binet)** |  | 1,481 | 47.6% |
| 4 | [Piers Sangan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/piers-sangan) |  | 1,307 | 42% |
| 5 | [Philip Le Claire](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/philip-le-claire) | Jersey Alliance | 792 | 25.5% |
| 6 | [Guy de Faye](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye) |  | 491 | 15.8% |

3,111 ballots (inc. 26 spoilt papers)

6,403 registered voters

48.6% turnout

* * *

### 2026 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (2 seats), 7th June 2026.

- [Rose Binet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rose-binet) : Current Deputy of District 9 \[[app.jerseyeveningpost.com](https://app.jerseyeveningpost.com/assistant-minister-hopes-for-re-election-in-eastern-district/content.html)\]
- [Carolyn Labey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey) : Current Deputy of District 9 \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/09/long-serving-deputy-to-stand-again/)\]
- [Scott Wickenden](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/scott-wickenden) : Previous States Member \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/07/too-much-time-has-been-lost-to-political-infighting-former-minister-seeks-return-to-states/)\]
